transcript.content: Hello, welcome in. What brings you to see me today?

I'm here because... well, it's been going on for almost two years now. Ever since that big commission. I just... I can't shake this absolute certainty that a few people in the ensemble are quietly undermining my work. They use schedule changes, where they choose to sit, little comments during rehearsals... it's all deliberate. Even when they show me emails or notes that supposedly explain it all away, I know what's really going on.
Have you ever heard voices, whispering, or other sounds when no one was around?
No. I don't... I don't hear things that aren't there. It's just the things they actually say and do.
Have you generally felt throughout your life that people can't be trusted, even before this commission two years ago?
No, not really. I mean, I've always been fine with people. It's just... this specific situation. Before that, everything was normal.
Over these past two years, have you experienced periods where you felt persistently down, depressed, or lost interest in things you usually enjoy?
No... not really. I mean, I still care about the music. I just... I'm just trying to do my job. I wouldn't say I've been depressed.
Have you ever felt as though an outside force or power was controlling your thoughts, body, or actions?
No. I... no. I make my own decisions. Nobody is controlling my thoughts or anything like that.
